classification: post-event retrospective development with separate prospective commitments

hypotheses.primary: A LoRA-trained model directly predicts rental log-price changes competitively with official numerical controls
hypotheses.secondary: Origin-safe supplementary evidence improves the matched direct model

data.series_selection: First two lexicographic exact headline daily-statistic series per approved source and GPU family, capped at 12; no performance-based selection

evaluation.selection: Lowest development 7-day mean USD quantile pinball; earliest update wins exact ties; checkpoint zero eligible
evaluation.eligible: Origin observation exists, at least 20 context observations, and all 1/3/7-day labels exist; locked before candidate evaluation
evaluation.uncertainty: Origin-level paired differences and range; three dependent retrospective origins are insufficient for population significance

gates.evidence: Require frozen origin-safe sources with verified availability and varying features across training; current retrieval alone is ineligible
gates.rl: Separate unlaunched experiment; proper reward and verified credit assignment required

prospective.resolution: Compatible verified outcomes only; pending until labels mature
prospective.cohort: Exact existing signals-v6 contract IDs; separate transfer cohort from competition medians
prospective.training_update: Frozen selected checkpoint; no prequential retraining in first panel
